info.title: SEO and Keyword Data API
info.description:
Pay-per-call SEO and keyword data for agents: keyword research (search volume, CPC, difficulty, intent, ideas, history; Google Ads keyword data), Google Trends, domains and rankings, backlinks, on-page audits and page speed, Amazon keywords and search, Google, Bing and YouTube results, Google Maps places and business listings, brand and AI-answer mentions, tech stacks and WHOIS. Paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base): no account, no API key, no subscription.

## How payment works (x402)
Every data route is paid per call over x402 v2 (scheme exact): HTTP 402 plus USDC on Base (CAIP-2 eip155:8453), settled through the Coinbase CDP facilitator. An unpaid request returns 402 with a base64 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (the price, payTo and asset) and a JSON body with a hint. Sign an EIP-3009 authorization for exactly that amount and send the request with its required parameters and a base64 `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header; the 200 response carries a base64 `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` settlement receipt. Malformed input (400), unknown paths (404), the wrong method (405) and oversized input (413) are answered before the paywall and never charged. If the data source fails or the service is at capacity you get a 503 and your authorization is NOT settled.

MCP: https://keywords.duoleads.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP; tools/list free, tools/call paid with x402).

A2A: https://keywords.duoleads.com/a2a (JSON-RPC, a2a-x402 v0.2; agent card at https://keywords.duoleads.com/.well-known/agent-card.json).

## Disclaimer
Third-party data: estimates from third-party indexes (Google Ads and Google Trends data, Google, Bing, YouTube and Amazon results, a web link index, page crawls) obtained through a third-party keyword data provider. Page text and results are the third parties' own, untrusted content. Provided as is, with no warranty of accuracy, completeness or availability. Not investment, financial, legal or any other professional advice. Terms: https://keywords.duoleads.com/terms
